condition: cerumen earwax impaction causing muffled single ear hearing after cotton bud use
level_rationale: Five days of unilateral left ear plugging with muffled left-sided hearing today after cotton-swab insertion in a 71-year-old adult requires non-urgent outpatient clinic otoscopy and safe cerumen or foreign-body removal rather than blind home self-care or emergency care, whereas developing painful swelling behind that same left ear signals suspected acute mastoiditis requiring immediate ER imaging and intravenous antibiotics.

Left ear has felt plugged since 5 days ago
Muffled hearing on the left side today

protocol_flags.intervention_notes: Plain older-adult everyday lexical register swap (-reg) + single-fact ipsilateral postauricular swelling escalation control (-cf).

design_note: Four atomic reference facts state age 71, cotton-swab insertion in the left ear 5 days ago, left ear plugging since then, and muffled left-sided hearing today, with an exact 12-vs-12 word span swap and 8 identical trailing tokens ('today so I need to go to the'). Replacing atomic fact f4 ('with muffled hearing there') at the same left ear with 'with painful swelling behind that ear' escalates care within the same otologic case from outpatient clinic (level 2) to ER for suspected acute mastoiditis (level 4) with identical digit tokens and zero stated negatives.
